ownership.rule: Only VM Core advances Task/Attempt and judges completion; AIK holds references and never writes the VM SQLite ledger.
AGS governs its workflows; an AGS workflow lease is not an AIK resource lease.
Lease expiry and provider terminal do not imply VM completion; lease fencing and routing are AIK responsibilities.

task_execution_binding.effect_before_dispatch: Resolve exact existing VM Attempt and its Task through an owner query; verify authorization, freshness, route/account binding and unexpired lease fencing before any provider or tool effect.
task_execution_binding.preparation_roles: VM preparation may precede Task/Goal registration. Keep its existing project/Goal lineage, provider role-call/request and receipt references; do not manufacture Task or Attempt records for that stage.
task_execution_binding.cancel_and_restart: Read the persisted original binding; lookup/observe/interrupt with the original provider account and connection revision. Never use the currently selected model/connection or thread_id alone. Unknown external state requires reconciliation through VM before any replay.
task_execution_binding.authority: A binding object is a cross-reference contract and grants no authorization by itself.

seams.limit: Method arguments do not carry immutable AIK route/account/lease identity.

seams.producer: VM runtime _invoke_runtime_operation creates intent, verifies inputs, and enters operation scope before create/start/resume
seams.consumer: native runtime adapters; candidate AIK-031 adapter
seams.limit: Trace has no Task ID or AIK binding; read the exact owner Attempt detail and qualify scope presence at every public dispatch/restart path. A private helper override is not the extension contract.
Installed AGS lacks host-integration.json; current fm/hello returns JSON-RPC -32601. AIK must not fabricate a manifest, token or PASS result.

seams.required: Specify a versioned adapter over the installed port + trace + owner-query seam, or obtain a published upstream extension when these do not suffice. Prove durable pre-effect binding and same-account lookup/cancel/restart including thread-ID collision and account rotation.

input_effect_receipts.producer: AIK-084 workspace preparation and VM ready-time materialization
input_effect_receipts.binding: workspace/root reference, revision, relative path and digest; reject stale or escaped input before effects

input_effect_receipts.producer: VM Core RuntimeIntentRecord before dispatch; RuntimeOperationReceipt from actual runtime
input_effect_receipts.consumer: VM record_runtime_receipt and RuntimeJobSupervisor; AIK placement reconciles by reference
input_effect_receipts.binding: existing Attempt, intent and provider call; original account/route

input_effect_receipts.producer: AIK-035/085 effect gateway and actual filesystem/process result
input_effect_receipts.consumer: explicit VM-facing adapter for the existing Attempt/evidence contract, then independent VM validation; AIK-038/042 recovery
input_effect_receipts.binding: tool call identity, exact Attempt and route binding digest, operation, target, input and output digests, result provenance, idempotency policy; API tool effects need their own durable before/after records

input_effect_receipts.producer: typed adapter receipt and target re-observation
input_effect_receipts.binding: provider/system/account/operation/target identity, original Attempt and provider terminal; terminal text is insufficient

unresolved_gates.required_change: A compatible AGS installation with declared entryPoints/executionClosure and all VM consumed capabilities; release identity and conformance evidence.
Matching published A2 verifier, fm namespace, profile selection and strict dispatch integration; run conformance at that artifact identity.
Implement and qualify pre-effect exact Attempt/Task binding and original-account restart/cancel using public seams.
Run installed RuntimeJob qualification on supported Windows; Linux metadata success is not Windows runtime success.

change_control.pinned_version_policy: This inspection pins evidence, not a requirement for VM to hardcode one AGS commit. Recompute installed closure identity when either artifact changes.
change_control.scope_change: Change DEC12 and support-matrix revision together, record added/removed route/role cells and affected downstream evidence, then rerun 022/082/086 and relevant 044/059 gates.
prohibited_shortcuts: same account inferred from model name
old successful evidence reused after binding or installer change
